research_result.description: Intercom is an AI customer service platform providing customer support, messaging, inbox management, articles, and automated customer engagement capabilities via SDKs, REST APIs, and MCP.
research_result.credential_requirements: Developers can create a free development workspace in Intercom's Developer Hub to get an Access Token for private apps or configure OAuth for public apps.

evidence.claim: Intercom supports API authentication via Access Tokens (for private apps) and OAuth (for public apps), both sent via Bearer authorization headers.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: To access the Intercom API, you have two authentication options depending on whether you app is public or private.

evidence.claim: Developers can create free development workspaces for building and testing integrations.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: Development workspaces are free and intended for development purposes only.

evidence.claim: Intercom provides a comprehensive REST API.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: This is documentation for version 2.16 of the REST API.

evidence.claim: Intercom provides an official remote MCP server for AI tools.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: Intercom hosts a remote MCP server that follows the authenticated remote MCP specification.
